# Proposed Lucide replacements — staging only

**Not integrated.** These files are separate proposals and are not in the live GUI asset directory. Existing LogSentinel assets remain unchanged. Preparing these files does not prove the historical source or ownership of the originals, grant rights, approve publication, or clear the Windows binary.

The four SVGs below are isolated Lucide proposals, not live GUI assets. Each was sourced from the exact pinned Lucide revision in the table and modified only by replacing the SVG stroke token `currentColor` with `CURRENT_COLOR` for the existing GUI loader. The `folder-open` proposal is named `folder_open.svg` to match the LogSentinel target; the upstream path remains `icons/folder-open.svg`. These records distinguish pinned source bytes from the corrected proposal bytes.

## License and attribution coverage

- `LICENSE-LUCIDE-AT-PINNED-SOURCE-COMMITS.txt` is the exact Lucide `LICENSE` file at all four pinned icon commits (SHA-256 `1e7290b35280a048667bbf0ebabac1c7fd52a75300e8b2946ac165715997f2bc`). It supplies the Lucide ISC text and the historical general statement that portions are held by Cole Bemis 2013–2022 as part of Feather under MIT. It does not identify the individual Feather-derived icons or include the separate full Feather MIT text.
- `LICENSE-LUCIDE-CURRENT-SNAPSHOT.txt` is the official Lucide license at commit `4bf621064bed45d114ba31435b85760513830d1c` (SHA-256 `b495047bd93a9b06913511076f504daba17d5bbeb3e0650f3bb53a4220329c57`). That later list identifies `check`, `download`, and `x` as Feather-derived; it does not list `folder-open`. This later classification is useful attribution evidence, but does not establish which classification applied at the four distinct pinned commits.
- `LICENSE-FEATHER-MIT-v4.29.1.txt` is the official Feather v4.29.1 MIT text (SHA-256 `308028e93fcf84972523cdf6e616f73168546b4953895f516d01287f16fe7bee`). Its inclusion provides the text for review, not proof that v4.29.1 was the source version for these files or that this MIT notice applies to a particular pinned Lucide icon.
- **Coverage assessment:** the bundle retains the available Lucide ISC notice and Feather MIT reference text, but exact per-icon applicability of Feather terms at the pinned revisions is not established by the pinned license evidence. Current Lucide evidence points to Feather attribution for three names and not the fourth, without proving that historical scope. The required attribution/notice placement for any eventual distribution has not been decided. Confirm the version-specific scope and notice handling with the project owner/legal reviewer before integration or publication. This record makes no legal conclusion and does not elect terms for the original LogSentinel artwork.

## Comparison and validation

The source-byte hashes/Git blob SHA-1 values identify the pinned raw Lucide SVGs; each is restored by changing only the proposal's `CURRENT_COLOR` token back to `currentColor`. The corrected proposal hashes above identify the bytes as staged. All four proposals parse as XML and their path-data multisets match the corresponding existing SVG geometry. Upstream stroke width is 2 versus 1.8 in the existing GUI originals. The local `download.svg` path order differs, so path-list order was not treated as an exact match. The correction report documents the restore-hash checks and GUI-loader color rendering. This does not prove historical provenance or ownership of the existing originals.

No proposed SVG was copied into `src/logsentinel/gui/assets/`. No GUI source, tests, packaging specifications, references, dependencies, or release artifacts were changed.
